evidence.detail: Exact v308 loads configs/maps.yaml or compiled configs/m.bin and parses keys id, map, land, type, osid, group and forceroof/forceroofs.
The cache index loader constructs this class and passes the live region-id, map-archive, land-archive and type arrays into it; configured entries rewrite those arrays in place.

The registry builds exact lookup state for configured region ids, map/land archive ids, OSRS-region membership, group labels and region->OSRS id remaps; region loading consults those tables during coordinate/archive resolution.
forceroof/forceroofs entries set the client region-override map for the configured region id, showing this class owns presentation/runtime map-region overrides rather than raw cache decoding alone.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for maps.yaml-driven region/map/land/runtime override state. It does not claim server world authority.
